jobs.title: Research Officer
jobs.why: Research consulting firm (research, M&E, data) in the social development sector. Matches your 2 years as Research Analyst at BBN and your data work. They ask for SPSS, Stata or R; you use Python, so say so clearly.
jobs.requirements: Master's degree; 3-4 years in research, M&E or development consulting. Apply by email: jobs@progressinccompany.com, subject 'Application for Research Officer – [Your Name]'.

pay.note: Not posted. Research officer roles in Nepal usually pay about NPR 40k–90k a month.

jobs.title: Short Term Consultant – Support to Operations, Nepal
jobs.why: IFC invests in Nepali banks, including NMB's green bond. Your banking, credit risk and analytics background suits IFC operations work. Short-term contract, so check it fits around your job.
jobs.requirements: Posted on LinkedIn about 20 Nov 2026. Deadline not confirmed. Search the title on LinkedIn or the World Bank careers site.

pay.note: Short-term consultant. The fee is agreed per day. Ask for the daily rate.

jobs.title: Climate, Resilience and Agriculture Officer (Nepali nationals)
jobs.why: Strong climate theme, but the role is field and agriculture focused. Your finance and data skills are only a partial match.
jobs.requirements: Posted on LinkedIn in November 2026. Deadline not confirmed. Search the title on LinkedIn.

pay.note: Not posted. INGO officer roles usually pay about NPR 80k–150k a month.

jobs.title: Gender and Climate Finance Consultant (home-based, Asia-Pacific)
jobs.why: Closed. Shows UN agencies hire home-based climate finance consultants for Asia-Pacific. It asked for 5+ years in climate or sustainable finance, which you are building now.
jobs.requirements: Master's degree; 5+ years in climate finance, sustainable finance or development.

pay.note: International consultancy, usually paid in USD. Often well above Nepal market pay.

jobs.title: SDG Finance and Private Sector Development Research Intern (home-based)
jobs.why: Closed. A very good fit for a Master's student with finance and research experience. UNDP runs this kind of internship often. Watch for the next round.
jobs.requirements: Enrolled student or recent graduate; 6-month internship.

pay.note: Internship with a small stipend at most. Pays much less than a job, so treat it as experience only.

jobs.title: Consultant – Learning Designer, Sustainable Finance / Landscape Finance (home-based)
jobs.why: Closed. A 12-month remote consultancy on sustainable finance learning content. Shows this kind of remote work exists.
jobs.requirements: Learning design plus sustainable finance knowledge.

pay.note: Remote consultancy. The fee was not shown.

jobs.title: Coordinator – United Nations University (UNU) Hub
jobs.why: Closed. ICIMOD posts a few times a month. Set a job alert on their vacancies page.

pay.note: ICIMOD says its pay is competitive with international organisations. Exact scale not posted.

jobs.title: Project Officer – Financial Inclusion (PROSPER project)
jobs.why: Closed (September 2026). This is the best type of match for you: working with banks and fintechs to design inclusive credit and green-finance products. Watch Heifer, Practical Action, Helvetas and Swisscontact for similar roles.
jobs.requirements: Experience in financial inclusion, loan facilitation and working with financial institutions.

pay.note: Not posted. INGO officer roles usually pay about NPR 80k–150k a month.

jobs.title: Young ICIMOD Professionals Programme (YIPP) 2025/26
jobs.why: Last call closed 31 Jul 2025 (about 10 places). Needs a Master's; management counts, so your MBA qualifies. 2-3 years of experience preferred; you have more. Watch for the next call around June-July.
jobs.requirements: Master's degree; nationals of ICIMOD member countries (Nepal included); 12-18 months, full-time at HQ.

pay.note: USD 16,487 a year plus housing allowance and insurance. About NPR 2.1 lakh a month before tax (at about NPR 152 per USD).
